title: nan
authors: Huang T.; Zhou Y.; Zhang B.
key_contribution: Presents an image matching-based visual-inertial integrated navigation system using deep learning feature matching, ESKF fusion, and Kalman innovation mismatch detection for UAVs in GNSS-denied environments.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Filter_Based_VIO to ensure precise positioning.
